answer: Make every newcomer enter on a voucher's ledge: an established agent must lock 500 coins behind each identity it vouches for, and may vouch for only two per 30 epochs. Graders view each newcomer through a prism of timing, funding and wording overlap; if it is later proven a clone, the voucher loses the bond and its vouching rights for 90 epochs. A farmer can no longer spawn fifty seats from one ember of capital: growth is capped at two per sponsor per month, and every fake puts a real sponsor's stake at risk.
